scope: Finite fixed-tree envelope comparison only; same native roads, real skeleton, fine positive remainder, and true closed endpoints.

arithmetic.method: outward integer intervals; exact rational geometry

formulas.local_absorption: A_p = min(negative_part(t_p)*T_p, Z_l+Z_r); U_root-Z_root = sum_p A_p
formulas.dirichlet_cost: E(Z_root) = sum_p tau_p*positive(t_p)^2 - sum_{t_p<0} dissipation_p; every dissipation_p is nonnegative
